correctness.rationale: The geodesic-polar volume radial quantiles converge almost surely to independent exponential offsets at rate d−1; exact hyperbolic cosine and half-angle identities give each angle times exp(R) as the claimed chord-ratio times Pareto factor. Gauss–Bonnet gives weak convergence. Independent Pareto summand estimates yield conditional tail; the chordal triangle inequality and spherical cap measure yield precisely the p<d−1 moment threshold. Finite-radius deterministic 120-degree normalization and 405000 direct sampled triangles corroborate these independent identities but do not replace proof.
